quiz.q: Sugar mills are usually located near cane fields because sugarcane:
quiz.why: Right. Cane is bulky, loses weight in processing and its sucrose drops after cutting.

Because iron ore and coal are heavy, and they're nearby.

Whichever costs most to move usually wins.
